mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD(boardNum, memberId, title, content) VALUES (nextval("board_seq"), #{memberId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT b.boardNum AS boardNum, b.title AS title, b.content AS content, b.boardDate AS boardDate, m.memberId AS memberId , m.phone AS phone FROM board b INNER JOIN member m ON b.memberId = m.memberId ORDER BY b.boardNum
SELECT boardNum, memberId, title, content, boardDate FROM BOARD WHERE memberId = #{memberId}
